guard.note: client only, once (init flag): constructs the volume thread and starts it (the redirected start call)
the thread body: while volumeHandling, the first pass compares the master volume with 0.0, updateVolume on a change, sleep 100 ms
the only writer that adds a clip: put, then setVolume (the wrapped call) as the last statement of a success
setVolume of every clip with the current master volume (the held thread's first pass repeats it)
the gain write: a pure function of the clip's control range and the percentage (so a repeat is identical)
declared methods: only registerSound puts into the sound map; no getter exposes the map or the thread
the caller: SoundHandler.init() then updateVolume() (no clip yet), once at client init

konkrete_volume_thread_lazy_start.conversion: @Redirect of Thread.start() in SoundHandler.init(): with the switch on the constructed thread is held; @WrapOperation of the setVolume call at the end of a successful registerSound(): after it ran, the held thread starts once (helper bons.furious.patch.konkrete_c49.KonkreteLazyStart)
